notes.title: 2025-08-11 Ver 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[p]Thank you to everyone who has fun playing Imperator with Nothing to Do! I have compiled and improved the points that have been modified since version 1.0.2.[/p][p][/p][h1]Convenience[/h1][p]
Added hints regarding the conditions for completing hidden challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][strike]Fixed a bug where pressing F12 would return you to the screen.[/strike][/p][p]Currently, intermittent errors occur when pressing the F12 key, and we are working to improve this issue. Please use the PRT SC function to take screenshots.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]Typo Miss[/h1][p][/p][p]Some terms and nouns have been revised to reflect foreign language notation and standard language.[/p][p][/p][p]Some typos have been corrected.[/p][p][/p][h1]ETC[/h1][p]
Some graphical bugs have been fixed.
[/p][p]I'll be back with another update later![/p]

notes.title: 2024-02-24 Ver 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has fun playing Imperator with Nothing to Do! I gathered opinions after version 1.0.1 and patched the areas that could be improved as much as possible.

[h1]Convenience[/h1]
[list]
[*]Pressing F5 gives you full screen, although it's incomplete. The key to open an existing window is F6.
[/list][list]
[*]A settings window has been added. It provides convenient functions such as sound control, dialogue window speed control, and battle animation settings.
[/list][list]
[*]The conditions for achieving hidden challenges have been relaxed.
[/list]

[h1]Typo Miss[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some ambiguous expressions have been corrected.
[/list][list]
[*]Some typos have been corrected.
[/list]

[h1]ETC[/h1]
[list]
[*]Some graphical bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: 2024-02-24 Ver 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has fun playing Imperator with Nothing to Do! A patch has been released based on feedback from the initial release period.

[h1]Convenience[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now you can press the Ctrl key to quickly skip through the texts.
[/list]

[h1]Typo Miss[/h1]
[list]

[/list]

[h1]ETC[/h1]
[list]

[/list][list]
[*]Credits added.
[/list]
